lines: Arithmetic on a locker number means nothing --- a ``mean locker number'' describes
no student. The digits are labels, so locker number is categorical.
Of the 40 Ashford students surveyed, 18 --- or $45\%$ --- ride the bus to school,
Stage 2, collect data. Students who do not ride the bus were never in the bus line,
so they could never be chosen --- the flaw entered there, not at stage 4.
A statistic --- it describes the 40 cardholders surveyed, not all 1,000.
Time --- surveying every one of 1,000 cardholders would take far too long.
The homerooms are grouped by grade, so a homeroom is alike inside --- a stratum, not
a mix of the whole. Two homerooms would be one or two grades and miss the rest.
